notes.title: Patch Notes #3
notes.content:
Hello again, brain heads! I don't know how many more updates this game is going to receive, but we will keep providing! This is now version 1.5.3


New:
Info bubble for the erase data option. This makes it clear as to what it does and doesn't erase.

The APPLY button in OPTIONS will become opaque if you make changes.

Added three new 'creepy' fun facts on the broken loading screen.

Pompy's topics will now show when they can be pressed via 'golden burst'.

Added two new SFX. One for the 'golden burst' & completing PomPom's puzzle.
Changes:
Updated Silent Smile credit and link.

Removed QR code and replaced with an instant link.

Replace the "What do you think death feels like?" question.

Tweaked the questions in the broken quiz.

Changed resolution option info description.

NOTE on the launcher has been updated visually.

Deleted the 'I have eyes everywhere' and binary fun facts from the loading screen.

Fullscreen warning text has been updated.
Fixes:
Penalties will no longer interrupt the Pompy-related questions in quiz 2.

PomPom's puzzle doesn't get stuck anymore.

Caption glitch doesn't show up if captions are disabled.

notes.title: Patch Notes #2
notes.content:
Hello again, brain heads! We have another patch of updates for you all here. This is now version 1.5.2

Spoilers for the update below, so be warned.


New:
Running out of time in a quiz docks 30 points from your score.

New glitch animation for when Mr. Pompy says "Hello, Sarah!"

The penalty box has a new design.

Silent Smile now added to SPECIAL THANKS & CREDITS.
Changes:
The point system has been changed, so it should be easier to get an F rank.

Changed the border for the broken RESULTS screen.

Changed Mr. Pompy's dialogue text during the monochromatic speech.

Changed Leo portrait in CREDITS.
Fixes:
"It's always raining" achievement gets unlocked much earlier now.

You can no longer get the same penalty in a row.



Enjoy this new round of updates, Players :-)



Sincerely, Light Thoughts.

notes.title: First Major Update Patch
notes.content:
Hello again, brain heads! Hope you all are enjoying the 1.5.0 update. We have here a new patch (already) that fixed some things and added a few new changes. This is now version 1.5.1

Spoilers for the update below, so be warned.
New:
- Holding the "DEL" key on the launcher will erase ALL data, excluding option preferences.

- Added counter to volume meter.


Changes:
- You can skip the title opener with "Spacebar" or by double-clicking.

- FPS option goes up to 45 fps.

- Replace two cutscenes with MP4 versions.

- "Who's your favorite family member?" question appears more often.

- Changed how the penalty secret activates.


Fixes:
- Fixed PomPom theme (shop music) starting over when plushie clicked.

- Fixed "SUBTITLE" appearing when clicking.

- Fixed hover cursor showing up after getting topic-key.

- The static in the closet scene will not show up after "Think on it ;)"

- Fixed being able to watch PomPom/Patrick cutscene twice.



Enjoy this round of updates, Players :-)



Sincerely, Light Thoughts.

notes.title: Mr. Pompy's Extravagant Quiz FINAL UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello all! We here at Light Thoughts are excited to announce that the LAST MAJOR UPDATE to Mr. Pompy's Extravagant Quiz is here!! While this is the last major update, there will of course be future patches if any bugs are noticed. Anyways, please enjoy this update as we'll be away for quite some time.



If you have any questions or feedback, email us (lightthoughts98@gmail.com) and remember brain heads: Discover the light within your mind. 



Spoilers for the update below, so be warned.


NEW:
Achievements have now been added (Steam only).

You can now read some of the books in Patrick's Library.

New scares.

Secrets are sprinkled throughout the game. Can you find them all?

Fanart screen to showcase the community's art for the game, which can be found in the CREDITS menu once you've finished the game once.

Mr. Pompy now has new animation and dialog when you choose to trust him or not.

Silent Mansion easter egg in PomPom's shop.

Warning screen can be skipped via a popup when you first launch the game.

You can skip the Light Thoughts intro with "Spacebar" or by double clicking.

You can skip the final cutscene.

You can erase your saved data in the OPTIONS menu. This excludes achievements, credits, and the warning screen.

There is now tabs in the OPTIONS menu to make options more organized.

New ranking: Ranking F.

New fun facts on the loading screen.

New night time variation of the stage screen, accompanied by a new night time track.

The game doesn't return to normal after credits. Something else happens. 

New animation for Mr. Pompy when you choose a topic after persisting him.

New game over variant in the broken quiz when answering a specific question wrong.

New PomPom ABOUT screen line.

Pompy Community put into the SPECIAL THANKS & CREDITS screen.


CHANGES:
Warning screen text has been changed slightly.

Numerous graphical upgrades have been made, such as: Stage screen backgrounds (normal & broken), launcher when you're heading into Mr. Pompy's speech, Saves screen (broken only), the crazy glitch when you persist Mr. Pompy, ABOUT screen (normal & broken), and more.

Quiz answers are now in random spots every question.

The broken quiz questions & answers have been tweaked to fall more inline with the lore.

The "Are you comfortable" question is now a popup and your answer changes the outcome.

Logo animation has been changed.

Subtitles have a new style and support a new font where if we need to, it can support multiple languages.

Broken title screen music was changed to an earlier version because the current one was too loud.

The "Hidden questions" penalty has a more chance of happening.

Error messages text has been changed to make it feel more believable.

Final cutscene has been remade.

Ending message after final cutscene has been changed.

"Monster" portrait has been redone.

ASpacedOutFlower has now been added to the Light Thoughts section of the CREDITS screen.

Items container have been changed visually, to make them more visible.

Borders for the quizzes have been changed to match their setting from the topic-gate.

Quizzes all have a distinct color associated with them. Quiz 1 is mostly pink, Quiz 2 is mostly blue.

The retry button for the GAME OVER screen is on a cooldown to give players enough time to see their penalty before retrying.

Buttons have been upgraded visually.

Reanimated the C rank animation for Mr. Pompy.

More Fullscreen events happen.

Several sound effects have been changed/upgraded.

You can use your scroll wheel for the volume in the OPTIONS menu (as well as the fanart section).


FIXES & BALANCES:
Dragging the topic-key doesn't get stuck when dragging anymore.

Shorten transitioning times such as the save files so people don't think there's nothing there upon checking it out.

Switching through the credits doesn't delete the arrows where they are supposed to show up.

The "max time is 15 secs" penalty makes it so that the timer cannot exceed 15. 

Fixed Isaac Newton's name for Patrick's puzzle.

Cutscenes and the intro have been replaced with video files to save up on game space.

Background animations, specifically glitches, now have less animation frames.

Duplicate/unused sprites have been deleted.

Fixed the trash can reverting back to its normal state once mouse has lifted off its glitch state.

Mr. Pompy won't break the game anymore. We think.



Once again, we'd like to thank everyone for enjoying Pompy and leaving your reviews! We will be taking a long break from Pompy-related stuff to recharge for when we make the full game. We will also be updating this game with bug fixes if any is found and possible language options.



Much love to anyone who checks out the update. Have fun, Players :-)



Sincerely, Light Thoughts.

notes.title: Mr. Pompy's Extravagant Quiz SUBTITLE UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello all! We hope you're getting your brain's worth of trivia from our 'lovable' mascot, Mr. Pompy. We've heard some of your feedback and we have come to deliver. This is Mr. Pompy's Extravagant Quiz UPDATE, version 1.4.5.

If you have any questions or feedback, email us at (lightthoughts98@gmail.com) and remember brain heads: Discover the light within your mind.

Major Updates:

• SUBTITLES
• Master Volume slider option
• Broken Quiz has been reworked
• Credits got a makeover

Minor Updates:

• Added a NEW animation
• Game Over SFX
• Launcher image updates as you progress through the game
• Error messages now show up to tell you to re-open the game
• Updated some questions & answers
• Updated the THANK YOU message at the end
• There is now a cooldown to select levels
• Removed the ITEM bag. This makes it so the items are more noticeable
• Added a time box for the register puzzle to make the clock more noticeable
• Warning screen text has been altered
• Moved the Credits option to make it more noticeable
• Added a TIP on the stage screen
• Updated Pompy speech text after death

Bug Fixes:

• Fixed 15-second penalty for Quiz 2 where it subtracted two from the timer instead of one.
• Fixed the V-Sync and video penalty toggle options.
• Deleting a save file will make the trash can icon stay gone.
• Fixed where you had to click PomPom and Patrick twice to proceed with their dialogue.
• Fixed the answer box scaled-up bug at the beginning of quizzes
• Stopped Pompy from breaking the game...maybe.


I want to humbly thank everyone who has shown the game some love and attention! With the amount of support that's been shown towards our little furballs, it only makes sense to do a full game in the future. But for now, we will continue to update this version to meet our and your needs. It's hard to say what and when the next update will be, but I hope that whenever that is, you guys will be pleasantly surprised.

Anyway, much love to anyone who checks out the update. Have fun, Players! Sincerely, LightThoughts.
